#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
const long long MASK = (1LL << 31) - 1;

long long modh(long long a, long long M, int h, long long mod) {
    long long r = a - ((M * (a & MASK) >> 31) + M * (a >> 31) >> (h - 31)) * mod;
    return r < mod ? r : r - mod;
}

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if ((n << (63 - x)) < 0)
            ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long b = mod;
    long long p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

int highestOneBit(int x) {
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    return 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(x));
}

int numberOfTrailingZeros(int x) {
    return __builtin_ctz(x);
}

int reverseBits(int x, int h) {
    int rev = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        rev = (rev << 1) | (x & 1);
        x >>= 1;
    }
    return rev;
}

vector<long long> ntt(const vector<long long>& src, int n, bool inv, long long P, long long g) {
    vector<long long> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n);
    int h = numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
    long long K = highestOneBit(P) << 1;
    int H = __builtin_ctzll(K) * 2;
    long long M = K * K / P;
    vector<int> wws(1 << (h - 1));
    long long dw = inv ? pow_mod(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) / n, P) : pow_mod(g, (P - 1) / n, P);
    long long w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < 1 << (h - 1); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    long long J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 1 << i; j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h - i), t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1)); k < 1 << (h - i - 1); k++, s++, t++) {
                long long u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                long long Q = (u << 32) * J >> 32;
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 1 << (h - i - 2); k++) wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = reverseBits(i, h);
        if (i < rev) {
            swap(dst[i], dst[rev]);
        }
    }
    if (inv) {
        long long in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }
    return dst;
}

vector<long long> convolve(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b, long long P, long long g) {
    int m = max(2, highestOneBit(max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size()) - 1) << 2);
    vector<long long> fa = ntt(a, m, false, P, g);
    vector<long long> fb;
    if (&a == &b) {
        fb = fa;
    } else {
        fb = ntt(b, m, false, P, g);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = (fa[i] * fb[i]) % P;
    }
    return ntt(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

class InputReader {
public:
    istringstream iss;
    string line;
    InputReader() {
        getline(cin, line);
        iss.str(line);
    }
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (iss.eof()) {
            getline(cin, line);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        iss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in;
    int N = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<long long> dig(11, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int d = in.nextInt();
        dig[10 - d] = 1;
    }
    int power = N / 2;
    vector<long long> res = {1};
    long long g = 3;
    for (int p = power; p > 0; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) {
            res = convolve(res, dig, MOD, g);
        }
        dig = convolve(dig, dig, MOD, g);
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (long long v : res) {
        ans = (ans + v * v) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
